newsitem.title: CHINA: Next HK budget to be month early in mid-Feb - radio.
newsitem.headline: Next HK budget to be month early in mid-Feb - radio.

text.p: Hong Kong is likely to present its 1998/99 budget a month earlier than normal, government radio reported on Friday.

Financial Secretary Donald Tsang is likely to unveil the budget for the year ending March 31, 1999 in mid-February next year instead of in the usual budget delivery month of March, the radio quoted unidentified "government sources" as saying.
The move is to ensure the territory's legislature can discuss and pass the budget before elections for a new legislature take place next May, the report said.
Work is already under way on some aspects of the budget and there are indications that the it could contain profit tax cuts, the radio said.
Government officials were not immediately available to comment.
